messages.author: a4c5d7d1c977b688
messages.subject: NUTS abort R
parts:
Dear group,

I am using NUTS on a model (attached). The data are quite large, but please let me know if they are needed; I can send them separately. I first only used NUTS on some intercept/slope parameters like the following, and the model works fine.

mcmcConf$removeSamplers(c('beta_lambda0_br', 'beta_rho_br', 'chi_stop_beta'))
mcmcConf$addSampler(target = c('beta_lambda0_br'), type = "NUTS")
mcmcConf$addSampler(target = c('beta_rho_br'), type = "NUTS")
mcmcConf$addSampler(target = c('chi_stop_beta'), type = "RW_block")

However, when I tried to use NUTS on two more parameters which are scalars, such as the following, R was always turned off automatically during the fit <- runMCMC(compiled$mcmc,... step. It will be greatly appreciated if anyone can let me know how to solve this issue. Thank you.

mcmcConf$removeSamplers(c('beta_lambda0_br', 'beta_rho_br', 'chi_stop_beta', 'kappa_lambda0_br', 'kappa_rho_br'))
mcmcConf$addSampler(target = c('beta_lambda0_br'), type = "NUTS")
mcmcConf$addSampler(target = c('beta_rho_br'), type = "NUTS")
mcmcConf$addSampler(target = c('chi_stop_beta'), type = "RW_block")
mcmcConf$addSampler(target = c('kappa_lambda0_br'), type = "NUTS")
mcmcConf$addSampler(target = c('kappa_rho_br'), type = "NUTS")

Best,
Qing

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: NUTS abort R
parts:
I don't think we can investigate without your data, so please do provide them off-list.

One thing to try would be to include kappa_lambda0_br (a scalar) in the block with beta_lambda0_br (a vector), since they are used in the same part of the model. And something similar to kappa_rho_br and beta_rho_br. (But regardless of whether that works, it would be good to see what problem you are encountering.)

(E.g. what I mean is 
mcmcConf$addSampler(target = c('beta_lambda0_br', 'kappa_lambda0_br'), type = "NUTS")
)

Perry
